headline: Agilent Research Catalyst Award Presented to Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo
summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., July 29, 2026--Agilent Technologies Inc. (NYSE: A) today announced that the Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo has received an Agilent Research Catalyst (ARC) Award on behalf of Professor Zongwei Cai. The award recognizes Professor Cai's innovative research focused on developing advanced analytical approaches for detecting per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and other emerging contaminants, a growing area of importance for environmental and public health research
